technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi A4/S4/RS4/Cabriolet (8E/8H): ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği, these are the most likely causes if the Basic Setting fails or the Fault comes back shortly after clearing. See TPI 0984403 for further details.
MY 2001: Steering Column Kontrol Modülü (J527) was the most common fault
MY 2002: Steering Angle Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G85) was the most common fault
MY 2003/2004: Experience has shown the Steering Angle Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G85) were the only cause, Steering Column Kontrol Modülü (J527) were not defective yet.
MY 2006/2007: Steering Column Kontrol Modülü (J527) was the most common fault
In many cases this code can be cleared out by a simple test drive
Several lock to lock turns (figure 8 turns) in a safe area
Short road test, 0.5km
Do the simple test drive 2 times in a row, then verify DTC is cleared out.
